svg.title: Berlin fixed participant mix pilot
svg.desc: Four scatter panels compare unweighted and fixed age/gender mix pace distributions. All edition values are in summaries.csv.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(98%,97%,95%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: Berlin: does the pattern survive the same participant mix?
16 editions, 2003-2018 | Four age bands within each recorded gender

g.text: 541,659 age-eligible records; 71 unclear ages excluded from both comparison series.
Each dot is one edition. Adjustment describes measured composition; it does not isolate a heat effect.
